details:
I have noticed recently that if an avatar has an excessive amount of particles, far beyond my limiter settings, it might be involved in stopping the IK of a user from loading completely. I know the particle systems have been removed because looking at the avatar performance stats there are no particles or particle systems listed.

This issue may not be isolated to the particle limiter as some users reported similar issues but to my knowledge I keep seeing this issue when someone loads an avatar to show large particle animations which I know is being restricted or removed by the particle limiter because my safety settings for friends has everything visible, or if I disable my safety settings for a non-friend their avatar IK still does not load.

Issue:
The avatar will load standing completely rigid upright with arms by their side. The loading bar will be stuck at 100% after downloading the avatar no matter how long I wait. If I try to reload their avatar, the avatar will load the same way all rigid but the loading bar will now say 0% and never move. If I try to rejoin the world or relaunch the game I could potentially no longer see their avatar and only the loading bar of 0% will be moving along the ground at their position. This might tell me that loading from the cache has more issues involved.
It may potentially be more of a problem with full body users but I can not confirm. I know that in the past the particle limiter had an issue which would completely stop avatars from loading but now it appears it may stop the IK from loading correctly as well.

Expectation:
The avatar successfully loads after 100% and their IK gets synced correctly.

My solution:
I had to remove the particle limiter from my config file and restart the game before their avatar and IK loaded correctly.
title: [825] Particle limiter may stop IK from loading on certain avatars
